problem: Trusted governance policy requires every DECISIONS.md change to use process classification, while the development contract also requires substantive feature decisions to update DECISIONS.md in the same feature PR. This makes compliant feature PRs unmergeable once the trust-boundary layer is reached.

decision.rationale: Keep DECISIONS.md governance-protected through same-PR manifest and governance evidence, but remove only the process-class requirement when DECISIONS.md is the sole governance file in a player-facing, economy or technical PR. Policy/workflow authority files still force process.

anti_pattern.observation: Treating a synchronized decision record exactly like a workflow/policy authority file creates mutually incompatible PR classifications.
anti_pattern.lesson: Preserve governance evidence while distinguishing decision-registry synchronization from policy-authority mutation.

findings: The exception is limited to DECISIONS.md as the sole governance file and does not suppress manifest/governance validation.
Any additional governance authority file keeps the process-only requirement.

governance.trust_boundary_change: DECISIONS.md remains governance-protected but no longer forces process classification when it is the only governance file in a player-facing/economy/technical PR. All workflow, policy, CODEOWNERS, AGENTS and governance-doc authority changes continue to require process.
governance.bypass_analysis: The wrapper filters only the process-class error for DECISIONS.md-only governance touches. The original validator still requires the evidence manifest to be changed in the same PR and validates governance trust_boundary_change, bypass_analysis and rollback fields. Adding any other governance file restores the process-only requirement.
governance.rollback: Revert the wrapper invocation, wrapper and tests together. This would re-block feature PRs that correctly synchronize DECISIONS.md but would not change game/runtime state.

known_limitations: The narrow wrapper exists to preserve base-policy history; it can later be folded into check_trust_boundary.py after the blocker is cleared.
